device.fastboot_wrapper_note: PowerShell treated fastboot progress on stderr as NativeCommandError and stopped retaining output after Sending OKAY; the target left fastboot, CDC enumerated, and runtime H424 boot=69ccb748 proves the boot action completed.

operation_summary: sequences 18-21: decmpfs metadata plus two 160631-byte reads at 80 and 82 ms
sequences 22-26: another FinderInfo ENOATTR, decmpfs metadata and two 8192-byte reads
sequences 28-32: decmpfs metadata and final 1276-byte read

exit.context: after the first UFS OCS timeout at 641.745810 s

lsd_lifecycle.interpretation: lsd was alive when the stable filesystem snapshot completed and remained alive for more than 300 seconds afterward. Its later SIGBUS occurred after the UFS fault cascade began.

bks.reply_delivery: S then D from pid 56 to SpringBoard pid 27 at time_ns 463247395625 and 463247399010
bks.interpretation: BKS closed successfully in this boot, but the first frame still did not occur. The BKS wait explains the early gate but is not a sufficient root cause.

image_attribution.reason: The first dyld range prototype selected implausible images and offsets, such as AudioToolbox for the fault PC. Raw PC, LR, slide and repeated frame addresses remain valid; image names from this probe must not be used.

image_probe_defects.plugin_build_marker: builder#2 still reports H420 even though the new image lines prove the new plugin loaded
image_probe_defects.lsd_sbpc_base: NATIVE_SBPC_IMAGE reports the shared-region base rather than the containing dyld image base; its reported lsd offset is invalid
image_probe_defects.trap_image_resolver: NATIVE_TRAP_IMAGE reports no-dyld-info for the sampled lsd pc/lr

conclusion.earliest_same_boot_evidence: The BKS request was already pending at the first capture gate and mediaserverd aborted before the first display gate.
conclusion.decisive_result: BKS later closed at 640.65 s, but display selector 3/4/5 and frame counters remained zero at 705.15 and 768.07 s.
conclusion.stable_launchservices_result: The first 32 operations now form a complete stable snapshot. The burst had completed by the gate, max latency was 103 ms, and lsd remained alive until 675.87 s.
ranked_causes: Repeated mediaserverd SIGABRT after Metal command-queue creation is the strongest demonstrated active failure on the renderer path
SpringBoard/launchd/BKS wait explains the early scene delay, but the later BKS reply proves it is not sufficient by itself
LaunchServices work delays readiness but is not a live blocked filesystem operation at the stable gate
UFS OCS/retry storm begins at 641.75 s and drives later process failures but does not explain the 350-369 s gate
IOMFB, IOSurface and scanout remain downstream because no frame or drawable was submitted
conclusion.next_probe: Keep the H424 stable XNU snapshot unchanged. Fix userland crash attribution with a manual Darwin dladdr ABI declaration, bump the plugin build marker, and log the last successful Metal call before each abort.
